r1.en:
ATK is increased by 12%. Casting Echo Skill within 10s after casting Intro Skill or Basic Attack grants 1 stack of Bamboo Cleaver, which grants 30% Heavy Attack DMG Bonus to the wielder. This effect can be triggered by Echoes of the same name once only, stacking up to 2 times, lasting for 12s. Casting Echo Skill at max stacks does not reset the duration. This effect can be triggered once every 10s and ends early if the wielder is switched off the field.
Casting Intro Skill grants 20% Echo Skill DMG Bonus to all Resonators in the team for 30s. Effects of the same name cannot be stacked.
r1.id:
ATK meningkat 12%. Menggunakan Echo Skill dalam 10 dtk setelah menggunakan Intro Skill atau Basic Attack memberi 1 stack Bamboo Cleaver, yang memberi 30% Heavy Attack DMG Bonus kepada pemakai. Efek ini hanya dapat dipicu sekali oleh Echo dengan nama yang sama, bertumpuk hingga 2 kali, selama 12 dtk. Menggunakan Echo Skill saat stack maksimum tidak mereset durasi. Efek ini dapat terpicu sekali setiap 10 dtk dan berakhir lebih awal jika pemakai diganti keluar dari lapangan.
Menggunakan Intro Skill memberi 20% Echo Skill DMG Bonus kepada semua Resonator di tim selama 30 dtk. Efek dengan nama yang sama tidak dapat bertumpuk.

r1.en: Increases Max HP by 12%. Casting Resonance Liberation restores 8 points of Concerto Energy, triggered once every 20s. Inflicting Glacio Chafe grants Snow Taint for 6s. Applying healing grants Ripples for 6s. If the wielder has done both while on the field, the next Outro Skill grants both effects for 6s. When the wielder has both Snow Taint and Ripples, the ATK of all nearby Resonators in the team is increased by 20%. Effects of the same name do not stack.
r1.id: Meningkatkan Max HP sebesar 12%. Menggunakan Resonance Liberation memulihkan 8 poin Concerto Energy, terpicu sekali setiap 20 dtk. Menimbulkan Glacio Chafe memberikan Snow Taint selama 6 dtk. Memberikan penyembuhan memberikan Ripples selama 6 dtk. Jika pemakai telah melakukan keduanya saat berada di lapangan, Outro Skill berikutnya memberikan kedua efek selama 6 dtk. Saat pemakai memiliki Snow Taint dan Ripples sekaligus, ATK semua Resonator di tim di sekitarnya meningkat sebesar 20%. Efek dengan nama yang sama tidak bertumpuk.

r1.en:

r1.en:

Hiss: each stack increases the wielder's ATK by 2% for 3s, stacking up to 10 times. Switching off the wielder clears all stacks. Gaining 10 stacks increases the wielder's Crit. Rate by 6%.

r1.en: Increases ATK by 12%. Casting Intro Skill or dealing Basic Attack DMG to targets increases the wielder's Basic Attack DMG Bonus by 36% for 4s. Effects of the same name cannot be stacked.

r1.en:
Grants 12% All-Attribute DMG Bonus. Casting Intro Skill or gaining a Shield as the active Resonator grants 1 stack of Nature's Order and 1 stack of Cradle of Life. This effect can be triggered via gaining a Shield once every 0.5s, stacking up to 6 times, lasting for 7s. Switching to another Resonator ends both Nature's Order and Cradle of Life immediately.
Nature's Order: Crit. DMG is increased by 4%, up to 24%. When Nature's Order reaches 6 stacks, the Crit. Rate of Heavy Attack DMG is increased by 12%.
Cradle of Life: Casting Heavy Attack consumes up to 2 stacks of Cradle of Life. For every 1 stacks of Cradle of Life consumed, Heavy Attack DMG ignores 15% of the target's DEF, up to 30%. The effect lasts for 2s.
r1.id:
Memberi 12% All-Attribute DMG Bonus. Menggunakan Intro Skill atau mendapat Shield sebagai Resonator aktif memberi 1 stack Nature's Order dan 1 stack Cradle of Life. Efek ini dapat terpicu lewat mendapat Shield sekali setiap 0,5 dtk, bertumpuk hingga 6 kali, selama 7 dtk. Berganti ke Resonator lain langsung mengakhiri Nature's Order dan Cradle of Life.
Nature's Order: Crit. DMG meningkat sebesar 4%, hingga 24%. Saat Nature's Order mencapai 6 stack, Crit. Rate Heavy Attack DMG meningkat sebesar 12%.
Cradle of Life: Menggunakan Heavy Attack mengonsumsi hingga 2 stack Cradle of Life. Untuk setiap 1 stack Cradle of Life yang dikonsumsi, Heavy Attack DMG mengabaikan 15% DEF target, hingga 30%. Efek berlangsung selama 2 dtk.

r1.en:
ATK is increased by 12%. Upon gaining Unison, the wielder gains 30% Electro DMG Bonus for 30s.
Upon gaining Unison, the wielder removes Yearning Mind and grants all Resonators in the team the Binding Mind effect: gain 24% Electro DMG Bonus for 30s. Effects of the same name cannot stack.
When the wielder consumes Concerto Energy, they remove Binding Mind from all Resonators in the team and gain the Yearning Mind effect: the wielder additionally gains 40% Electro DMG Bonus for 14s. Switching to another Resonator ends this effect early.
r1.id:
ATK meningkat 12%. Saat mendapat Unison, pemakai mendapat 30% Electro DMG Bonus selama 30 dtk.
Saat mendapat Unison, pemakai menghapus Yearning Mind dan memberi semua Resonator di tim efek Binding Mind: dapatkan 24% Electro DMG Bonus selama 30 dtk. Efek dengan nama yang sama tidak dapat bertumpuk.
Saat pemakai menggunakan Concerto Energy, mereka menghapus Binding Mind dari semua Resonator di tim dan mendapat efek Yearning Mind: pemakai mendapat tambahan 40% Electro DMG Bonus selama 14 dtk. Berganti ke Resonator lain mengakhiri efek ini lebih awal.

r2.en:
ATK is increased by 15%. Upon gaining Unison, the wielder gains 37.5% Electro DMG Bonus for 30s.
Upon gaining Unison, the wielder removes Yearning Mind and grants all Resonators in the team the Binding Mind effect: gain 30% Electro DMG Bonus for 30s. Effects of the same name cannot stack.
When the wielder consumes Concerto Energy, they remove Binding Mind from all Resonators in the team and gain the Yearning Mind effect: the wielder additionally gains 50% Electro DMG Bonus for 14s. Switching to another Resonator ends this effect early.

r1.en:
Increases ATK by 12%. Casting Echo Skill within 10s after casting Intro Skill or Basic Attacks grants 1 stacks of Gentle Dream. Echoes with the same name can only trigger this effect once, stacking up to 2 times, lasting for 10s. When reaching 2 stacks, casting Echo Skill no longer resets the duration of this effect. This effect activates up to once per 10s. Switching to another Resonator ends this effect early.
With 1 stacks: Grants 40% Basic Attack DMG Bonus.
With 2 stacks: Ignores 12% of the target's Havoc RES.
r1.id:
Meningkatkan ATK sebesar 12%. Menggunakan Echo Skill dalam 10 dtk setelah menggunakan Intro Skill atau Basic Attack memberi 1 stack Gentle Dream. Echo dengan nama yang sama hanya dapat memicu efek ini sekali, bertumpuk hingga 2 kali, selama 10 dtk. Saat mencapai 2 stack, menggunakan Echo Skill tidak lagi mereset durasi efek ini. Efek ini aktif maksimal sekali per 10 dtk. Berganti ke Resonator lain mengakhiri efek ini lebih awal.
Dengan 1 stack: Memberi 40% Basic Attack DMG Bonus.
Dengan 2 stack: Mengabaikan 12% Havoc RES target.
